comment: Nuxel charger/LPM boot-mode guard configuration (briq-01c).  This subpath is
the guard's OWN configuration home; it is not the touch-pipeline directory.
Userspace only: the guard classifies the current boot, publishes the state for
Settings and the live console, and can request ONE gated NORMAL reboot.  It
never writes a partition, a bootloader, a DTB, a modem, EFS or a partition
table, and it never enters recovery or Download Mode.
The permanent fix for 'an LPM power-up has no touchscreen' is a kernel change
NOT deployed.  No userspace code may pretend to resurrect a driver whose
reason_allow_reboot_false: allow_reboot is false in the config: touch is disabled on this boot and this device is not in an automatic-reboot configuration - unplug and reboot normally
enable_auto_reboot: To let the guard perform the reboot itself, set "allow_reboot": true here AND
acknowledgement flag is deliberate: a config edit alone must not be enough to
duplication_note: The same gate values are kept in configs/nuxel/touch/bootmode-guard.json because
an already-generated deploy plan names that path as the source for
asserts that the two files agree on every gate field, so the duplication is
enforced rather than trusted, and this subpath (searched first) is authoritative.
